checks: Original download entry is available before original bytes are fetched.
Opening ordinary View never fetches the original.
Ordinary View does not load editor, renderer, or draft modules.
Native overlay makes the background inert.
Blank replacement is rejected, never silently treated as remove.
External keep/remove/replace produces explicitly separate remix text.
Language changes preserve raw user intent and do not mutate Artwork or its original Prompt.
Actual browser original download is byte-identical after external edits.
Clipboard denial and popup blocking retain selectable text and a manual link.
A late old-language callback cannot overwrite the current-language Prompt.
A rejected stale language request cannot disable the latest successful Prompt actions.
Preview failure does not block Prompt actions.
Preview failure retains the registered cover.
404, wrong original hash, and decode failure reject without fake download success.
Variant failure retains current content; successful preview and Prompt commit once with the version callback.
A delayed original download stays byte-identical to the clicked Artwork after switching the visible character.
Every pending candidate keeps its own pending approval status.
Overlay restores invoking focus and background after closure.
